description: This file defines a state machine framework with classes for states, transitions, events, and configuration, including support for enum class hashing and external logging. It provides a generic implementation for finite state machines used within the beerocks namespace.

classes.name: beerocks_fsm_transition
classes.description: Represents a transition between states triggered by an event, with methods to access source, destination, and event, and to change the destination.

classes.name: beerocks_fsm_event
classes.description: Handles events in the FSM, including checking transition conditions and managing target states.

classes.name: beerocks_fsm_state
classes.description: Represents a state in the FSM, managing entry/exit actions and handling events to determine next state.

classes.name: beerocks_fsm_config
classes.description: Configures the FSM by defining states, entry/exit actions, and event handling logic.

classes.name: beerocks_fsm
classes.description: Implements the FSM logic, managing current state, starting, and firing events to transition between states.

methods.name: change_destination
methods.description: Overrides the destination state of a transition.

methods.name: check_condition
methods.description: Evaluates whether a transition condition is satisfied.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes an event and returns the next state.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Executes the entry action for a state.

methods.name: exit
methods.description: Executes the exit action for a state.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Fires an event in the FSM, causing state transitions if applicable.
